messages.subject: iframe + URL parameters
parts:
Hello,

I'm building a shiny app which uses URL parameters, using this code: https://gist.github.com/alexbbrown/6e77383b48a044191771

Now I also would like to be able to embed the app in html pages via iframe. Is there any easy way to pass URL parameters from the container page to the iframe and back? 

Thank you very much !

Joel
